caption: Sync now from the ribbon or the command palette: the notice says how many meetings came in and how many notes were made.
eval: (async () => { const p = app.plugins.plugins['call-notes-sync']; document.querySelectorAll('.modal-container .modal-close-button').forEach((b) => b.click()); try { app.setting.close(); } catch (e) {} if (!window.__csStub) { const src = await app.vault.adapter.read('Call Notes Sync/stub-calls.js'); new Function('app', 'return ' + src)(app); } const st = window.__csStub; const pause = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const lastOnly = () => { const ns = document.querySelectorAll('.notice-container .notice'); ns.forEach((n, i) => { if (i < ns.length - 1) n.remove(); }); }; const FF = 'Meetings/2026-10-05 Weekly product sync.md', FA = 'Meetings/2026-10-08 Quarterly planning.md'; const ensure = async () => { if (!app.vault.getFileByPath(FF) || !app.vault.getFileByPath(FA)) { await st.reset(); await p.syncNow(); await pause(500); } }; const open = async (path) => { await app.workspace.getLeaf(false).openFile(app.vault.getFileByPath(path), { state: { mode: 'preview' } }); await pause(700); }; st.setPro(false); await st.reset(); await p.syncNow(); await pause(700); lastOnly(); return 'ok'; })()
